analysis: The cosine-head trial completed successfully but reduced host macro validation HR@10 to 0.5613 from the supplied 0.5800 reference (−0.0187). Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.605, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.615, Electronics 0.425, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.600. Against the supplied category references, changes were −0.015, −0.030, −0.040, and +0.010, respectively. These results do not support the hypothesis that removing embedding-norm information improves this configuration; the cause of the decline is unproven. Host-allocated GPU time was 304.16 seconds. The final-score log line precedes additional diagnostics, contrary to the requested final-line placement.
code_summary: One independently trained MaskedSASRec per category, with tied item embeddings, a bidirectional two-layer Transformer, hidden size 96, two attention heads, length 64, dropout 0.2, and a jointly trained item bias. Removed the local convolution adapter. Scoring normalizes queries and item embeddings with eps=1e-8 and multiplies cosine similarity by exp(logit_scale), capped at 100 and initialized to 10. Training retains masked reconstruction, 256 sampled negatives, weighted final-mask loss, and AdamW. The exported predictor reconstructs this architecture and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category. Negative logits use an equivalent matrix implementation rather than directly calling the shared score helper. Code includes scoring, gradient, empty-history, and exported-predictor parity checks.
